body.name: Full contrast-and-shape local fiber
body.construction: For every fixed \(C_v<\infty\) and every \(n\) satisfying \(\sup_{h\in\mathcal H,\lVert v\rVert\le C_v}\lVert s(h,v)\rVert_\infty/\sqrt n<\delta_q\), the local fiber of causal laws is \(\{P_{p,q_n(h,v)}:h\in\mathcal H,\lVert v\rVert\le C_v\}\), where \(s(h,v)=S_0h+Wv\) and \(q_n(h,v)=q^0+s(h,v)/\sqrt n\).
